description: Official Microsoft Windows App Development CLI (winapp) agent plugin for GitHub Copilot, for developing native WinUI 3/XAML and Windows App SDK apps or adding Windows capabilities to existing Electron, .NET, C++, Rust, Flutter, and Tauri projects. Provides app scaffolding, WinUI sample and Windows API discovery, UI automation and testing, package identity, MSIX packaging, code signing, and Microsoft Store distribution.
